changeLog: v1 (2026-09-11): initial freeze. Requirement pool = batch_recording_item.requirement DISTINCT 36 (tmp/kb-ab/requirements-36.json, tunnel read-only 2026-09-11). 12 selected offline (human), card mapping fixed offline from data/kb/flows (flow/aliases/menu_path), NOT from v2 eval set (physical isolation).

v1 (2026-09-11): functionId per requirement verified against system_menu_snapshot v10 (system_node_id=1): 对公客户管理=7, 对公客户评级=9000000011, 客户信息查询=9000000039, 评级查询=9000000055, 产品库管理=9000000740, 查询产品信息=9000000467, 集群客户管理=9000000018, 风险分类统计=9000000144, 贷款计算器=9000000452.

Selection rationale: 6 query/read-only + inspection requirements (safe, fast, rollbackable) + 4 create-family (customer/product/cluster, difficulty-bearing, stamp-prefixed) + 2 mixed-navigation. Difficulty anchors preserved per spec S4 fallback: stamp customer family (#586/590/592/593/594) and credit_usage (#615) remain the v1.1 substitutes if pilot ceiling trips.

Cleanup caveat (accepted, documented): SUT customer rows in 信贷预客户 state have NO UI delete (state_actions: only 草稿客户 allows 删除). Create-family runs stamp every name with KBAB<runId>- and attempt list-delete when the state allows it; residue with visible stamp prefix is otherwise documented in cleanupLog and handed over. This mirrors the 2026-09-07 R1 precedent (8 stamp rows retained).

Known-stale pool entries excluded: 新增项目 family (12-18) has no matching menu/card in system_page (在审议/已上会项目管理 are 公共业务 unrelated); 删除评级 req (#35) is destructive on real data; 录制个人客户 (#36) ambiguous. Numbered-suffix 新增客户 variants (#21-34) are the same task as #2 (numbering artifact from batch template regeneration) - represented by #2.

environment.passwordSource: config/.env DB → system_account.id=2; password NEVER written to this manifest

armProtocol.retryPolicy: no auto-retry; exceptional retry run records retryOf

requirements.endpoint: 评级申请弹窗提交（评级对象=已有客户，模型自动带出）
requirements.cleanup: 无写数据（评级若提交成功为流程数据，stamp 无法前置——评级入口要求选已有客户；若申请发起成功按流程撤销；报告如实记录）
